update_description:
⚡ Faster Playback & A Fresh New Experience

* 🎵 Fixed Music Buffering: Improved buffering for smoother and more reliable music playback.
* ⚡ Fixed Playback Delay: Songs now start playing faster with reduced waiting time.
* 🍎 Apple Music-Inspired Player: Enjoy a cleaner and more modern music player experience.
* 🎨 Redesigned All Players: Music and video players have been completely redesigned with a fresh new look.
* 💧 Liquid Theme: Added a beautiful new Liquid-style design for dialogs and bottom sheets.
* ✨ Redesigned Dialogs & Sheets: Cleaner layouts with smoother and more modern animations.
* 🔋 Battery Optimization: Improved battery efficiency for longer usage and better performance.
* 🚀 Performance Improvements: Overall speed, stability, and responsiveness have been improved.

🎧 Enjoy the new V4.9.9 experience! 🔥
